Argentina / Las Leñas

Edificio Atenas

The apartments of the family of our founder, Juan Rodrigo, in the Edificio Atenas: of the four buildings of its complex, the one nearest the slopes. Most have two floors, with a double bedroom and the bathroom downstairs and a sofa bed and a cot upstairs, for four guests. We let them ourselves, for the ski season of the southern winter, from June to September.

In short

What to know.

  • In the Edificio Atenas, the building of its complex nearest the slopes
  • Two floors: a double bedroom and the bathroom downstairs, a sofa bed and a cot upstairs
  • For four guests
  • A kitchen with a dining table in the living room
  • Let by EverFlow itself: the apartments of our founder's family
  • For the ski season, from June to September

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

For couples, families and friends from Argentina, Brazil and beyond who want a ski week in the Andes with one host, in the apartments of the family of our founder, who grew up skiing here.

Good to know.

EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The apartments are the family's own, and EverFlow lets them directly; the terms come with your proposal.
